verdict.rationale: Orb supports rule-like automations tied to events: usage-threshold alerts that trigger notifications (orb-docs-6, orb-docs-29), real-time webhooks that fire on events for downstream actions (orb-docs-23), and automatic actions like dunning retries and automatic top-ups when balances deplete (orb-docs-19, orb-docs-37). These are event-triggered but are pre-built billing behaviors rather than a general user-defined rules/automation engine with custom conditional logic. Missing for 10: a documented rules-builder UI/API for arbitrary if-event-then-action logic, support for chaining multiple custom actions, and independent evidence of real-world automation workflows beyond billing-specific triggers.
